title: CI: add Ubuntu FIPS kernel target
description: The actual production deployment target: Ubuntu Pro + 5.15-fips kernel + CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_FORCE. This is the only CI target that exercises the FIPS code path end-to-end. build-test-wolfguard-aws.sh in ~/TICKETS/zScalar/ is a reference. Highest business value of all suggested targets.
close_reason: Ubuntu 22.04 FIPS passes 21/0 on kernel 5.15.0-1105-aws-fips. Added FIPS_MODE=1 + PRO_TOKEN env vars; Phase 0.5 does pro attach + fips-updates + reboot.
